name: tetraptych
title: Waku, four ways
text: The same orca, four flat palettes, one grid: a straight Warhol repetition, Ben-day dots standing in for the print screen he never actually ran through.

name: rising-sun
title: Waku, rising sun
text: Red and white, radiating: the flag-field treatment, not the flag itself. Kanji stamp reads 波, nami — wave, the thing Waku is named for.

name: great-wave
title: Waku, the great wave
text: A hand-drawn homage, not a reproduction: Hokusai's silhouette, simplified to three flat shapes, indigo and gold, Waku riding the crest instead of a fishing boat.

name: kabuki
title: Waku, kabuki paint
text: Kumadori face-paint stripes borrowed for the mask, not the man: red courage-lines on black, magenta ground, the Ben-day dot standing in for woodblock grain.
